name: ConPort SDD
description: Controls a ConPort project from Orca by SDD stage: epics in work with their spec and plan, specs waiting for a plan, ideas and team proposals, and epics outside SDD. Brainstorms an idea, plans and builds a spec, and starts the lead session of an epic in Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.

cover.alt: ConPort SDD: an idea becomes a spec, the spec is planned and built as an epic, and its branch is left to merge

screenshots.alt: Three ConPort SDD panels: sections by SDD stage, an epic with its harness, roles and live session, and the Plan & build sheet of a spec
screenshots.caption: Sections by SDD stage, an epic, Plan & build
